title: Scene
description: Self and every other vessel at one instant: the input evaluateScene reads (ADR 0023; the layer above the pair, colregs#135). Each (self, others[i]) pair is a Situation, with pairs[i] as its `pair`; roles stay pairwise, and the rest of the traffic is reduced to TrafficFacts. Structure only.

pairs.$comment: One per element of `others`, in order, when present.

subjects.$comment: The `others` input of reduceTraffic as well as of a Scene.
